regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows Big Banks as the prevailing narrative with high durability (0.72), full breadth, and a valid absolute-trend gate. Rotation is broad but the leader-challenger margin is wide (0.673); no confirmed handoff. The trend-gate historically helps here, making the eligible set the risk-controlled universe. Macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics and AI-tech, with high unscheduled-event share, adding to uncertainty.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate confirms eligibility, and the narrative shows high durability (0.72) with full breadth. Overweight justified by durable trend health, not rank. Crowding (z=1.2) is a sizing caution, not a fade signal.
theses.dissent: Crowded positioning and mixed Hurst tag increase the risk of a sharp reversal, especially if macro unscheduled events shift flows.

falsifier.text: Trend gate flips to ineligible OR durability bar falls below 0.5 — neutralise the lean.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Though eligible, the theme has low durability (0.47) and extremely narrow breadth (0.111), indicating a fragile trend that lacks broad participation. Underweight until trend health improves.
theses.dissent: Rank 3 score may signal early recovery; a mean-reversion rally could materialise if metals catch a bid from geopolitics or supply concerns.

falsifier.text: Breadth expands above 0.5 AND durability bar rises above 0.6 — shift to neutral.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Hurst tag 'mean-revert' and a low rank (11) signal no durable trend. Even though eligible, the theme lacks the trend-health characteristics seen in leaders. Underweight until evidence of a directional trend emerges.
theses.dissent: Defensive demand could improve if macro uncertainty deepens, temporarily lifting staples; the underweight is conditional on the absence of a trend, not a fundamental short.

falsifier.text: Hurst tag shifts to 'trend' AND durability bar exceeds 0.6 — neutralise.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
